author: ramprasadre56
name: grok-interface-kit
description: A high-fidelity chat interface inspired by xAI's Grok. Features a minimalist brutalist aesthetic, auto-resizing input, and a collapsible 'Thinking' process visualization for reasoning models. Built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Fully compatible with shadcn/ui and optimized for dark mode.
